name: antigravity-auth
description: Google Antigravity provider for OpenCode and Claude Code, built on core-auth — multi-account rotation, quota management, proxy support
author: intisy

scripts.build: npm --prefix core-ir install && npm --prefix core-ir run build && npm --prefix anthropic-translator install && npm --prefix anthropic-translator run build && npm --prefix core-auth/anthropic-translator install && npm --prefix core-auth/anthropic-translator run build && node core/teavm-build.mjs --java-dir java --module :antigravity-teavm --out src/generated/antigravity-orchestrator.teavm.js && npx tsc --project core-auth/tsconfig.json && node build.mjs
